result.summary: The image depicts a wide residential street with a signalized intersection and marked crosswalks. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic lights are present, the significant crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands increase exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra-style crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing a baseline level of safety. However, the wide roadway lacks a median refuge or curb extensions, leaving pedestrians exposed to traffic for a significant distance.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.
